title: Acquisition for Spherical-Linear Bayesian Optimization on the Cube
abstract: arXiv:2610.32628v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work demonstrated that executing Bayesian Optimization (BO) using simply a linear surrogate with a clever transformation is enough to approximate the performance of the standard Gaussian-Process (GP) based version on high-dimensional test functions. When the decision region is a sphere, this strategy admits rapid exact acquisition. However, it is the unit cube we encounter most often in the BO literature, and in this setting a standard approach, namely a multi-start quasi-Newton method, is employed for solving the acquisition subproblem. In this article, we will discuss a series of results, both positive and negative, regarding the complexity of global resolution of various acquisition subproblems over the unit cube. On the basis of this discussion, we will propose a new acquisition function which is globally optimizable using significantly less execution time than the incumbent approach while maintaining or improving performance.

translated_title: 立方体上球面-线性贝叶斯优化的采集函数
translated_abstract: 近期研究表明，仅使用线性代理模型并配合巧妙的变换来执行贝叶斯优化（BO），就足以在高维测试函数上逼近基于标准高斯过程（GP）方法的性能。当决策区域为球体时，该策略可以实现快速精确的采集。然而，在贝叶斯优化文献中最常遇到的决策区域是单位立方体，在这种情形下，通常采用标准方法（即多起点拟牛顿法）来求解采集子问题。在本文中，我们将讨论关于单位立方体上各种采集子问题全局求解复杂度的一系列正反两方面的结果。在此讨论的基础上，我们将提出一种新的采集函数，其全局优化所需的执行时间显著少于现有方法，同时能够保持或提高性能。
tldr: 本文分析了单位立方体上各类贝叶斯优化采集子问题全局求解的复杂度，并提出了一种新的采集函数，其全局优化耗时远少于现有多起点拟牛顿方法，同时保持或提升了优化性能。
en_tdlr: This paper analyzes the complexity of globally solving various Bayesian optimization acquisition subproblems over the unit cube and proposes a new acquisition function that can be globally optimized in significantly less execution time than the incumbent multi-start quasi-Newton approach while maintaining or improving performance.
